goal: Scaffold the asset pipeline tooling at tools/asset-pipeline/ per docs/05-ASSET_PIPELINE.md section 3. Empty stub modules with named exports + tests + a runnable CLI. No real provider integrations yet; that comes in spec 06.
constraints: Use the project's existing TypeScript setup; treat tools/asset-pipeline as a workspace package.
Allowed deps: zod, sharp, commander. Nothing else without an ADR.
Config schema validates the job shape declared in docs/05-ASSET_PIPELINE.md section 3.
CLI exposes `npm run assets -- <subcommand>` from the root package; subcommands stubbed: gen, process, pack, validate, manifest.
Procedural provider returns a synthesized solid-color PNG buffer for now (placeholder).
palette-check returns {ok: true} only if every pixel is in the loaded palette JSON.
README explains the pipeline at the level of one developer reading it for the first time.
acceptance: `npm install` at root installs the workspace.
`npm run assets -- validate jobs/_palettes/jazz.json` returns ok.
Unit tests cover: schema accept/reject, procedural-provider returns valid PNG header, palette-check accepts a one-color sample, manifest builder produces the documented JSON shape.
All tests pass via root `npm run test`.
verification: bash -c 'npm install --silent && npm run typecheck --silent && npm run test --silent'
